France Faces Fuel Crisis Amid Rising Prices and Protests

Fishermen and farmers in southern France have staged protests in recent weeks, blocking oil depots and port entrances due to surging fuel prices. These demonstrations are poised to become a significant political issue seven months ahead of the French presidential elections. The rising cost of fuel is reportedly being influenced by the war in the Middle East.
